text:
Priority: urgent
athena plan (and so drain's order) treats a dependency on a rejected job as met. Example: 20261029-142858-5c0p says it depends on 20261029-142853-x4nr, which was rejected twice and re-asked as 20261030-013143-as0j, yet the plan ordered 5c0p first and would have worked it before its dependency existed.
Change: a dependency is met only when the named job landed, or when a later job that landed is linked to it as its retry (retry link) or names it as the job it re-asks. A dependency on a rejected or failed job with no landed successor holds the dependent item back, with the reason shown under the plan's held-back items.
Acceptance:
- A test through athena plan shows an item that depends on a rejected job is held back with that reason, and is ordered after the successor once the successor landed.
- Existing plan and drain tests pass.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass.
- CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Files: crates/athena-cli/src/plan.rs, CHANGELOG.md
